comment: Allow-all seccomp profile that forces a few post-5.6 syscalls to ENOSYS so old build tooling (tar/glibc) and OE's pseudo fall back to the older syscalls pseudo actually intercepts. Needed because the container shares the (very new) host kernel; without this, pseudo misses tar's openat2() dir fds and do_package fails with 'Bad address' / 'got *at() syscall for unknown directory'.
